full_prompt_en: This square atmospheric illustration shows a solitary dark figure standing on a narrow ledge above a canal, facing a fantastically tall city in blue twilight. The figure is seen from behind near the left of center. A wide-brimmed hat, long dark coat, straight trousers, and small lit shoe edges make a simple silhouette against the luminous distance. The ledge projects from a shadowed masonry wall on the left, its transverse planks catching thin cyan highlights. A large suspension bridge enters from the right and crosses the middle of the image toward the left distance. Its long cable rises diagonally toward the upper right, while close trusswork and a sweeping arch repeat fine blue lines above the water. Beneath it, the canal extends straight toward a yellow-green glow at the horizon; narrow vertical reflections stretch across the blue surface. High, pointed towers and rectangular buildings crowd both sides of the receding waterway. They become paler and thinner with distance, creating a deep urban canyon without individual windows dominating the view. Overhead, the blue-green sky is filled with concentric, wavering line patterns, as if fine currents move through the air. Light comes mainly from the bright central distance and is scattered through the haze, leaving the foreground body and walls nearly black. Cyan edges and a few muted green accents pull those dark shapes into the surrounding atmosphere. The palette stays tightly within navy, teal, turquoise, and yellow-green. The picture feels quiet, mysterious, and immense, its single still silhouette measuring the scale of the bridge and needlelike skyline.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形氛围插画呈现一位孤独的深色人物，站在运河上方狭窄的平台上，面向蓝色暮光中高得奇异的城市。人物背对观看者，靠近中央偏左。宽檐帽、深色长外套、直裤与鞋边的小亮点，在发光远处前形成简洁剪影。平台从左侧暗砌墙伸出，横向木板接住细细的青色亮边。一座大型悬索桥从右侧进入，横过画面中部通向左侧远方。长缆线向右上方斜升，近处桁架与弯曲桥拱则在水面上方重复细密蓝线。桥下运河径直延伸到地平线的黄绿色微光，蓝水上拖着狭长的竖向倒影。尖顶高塔和矩形楼房挤在后退水道两侧。它们随距离变浅、变细，形成深邃城市峡谷，而不以单个窗户争夺注意。头顶的蓝绿天空布满同心般起伏的细线纹，仿佛气流在空气中流动。光主要来自明亮的中央远方，并在薄雾中散开，使前景人物和墙体近乎黑色。青色边光和少数低饱和绿调把这些暗形连回周围空气。色盘严格收在海军蓝、蓝绿、绿松石与黄绿之间。画面安静、神秘而宏大，唯一静止剪影衡量着桥梁与针尖般天际线的尺度。
style_prompt_en: Atmospheric illustration builds immense depth from nested silhouettes, repeating linear structures, and a narrow cool palette. Navy and near-black foreground masses give way to layered teal and turquoise midtones, then a pale yellow-green center of illumination. Fine parallel and rippling marks animate broad planes without breaking their smooth distance gradient. Strong diagonals and horizontal spans guide the gaze into a compressed luminous vanishing zone. Haze softens far edges while selective cyan rims separate the nearest dark forms. The visual result is hushed, enigmatic, and monumental, with intricate line rhythm inside a simple value hierarchy.
style_prompt_zh: 氛围插画以层层剪影、重复线性结构和狭窄冷色盘建立宏大纵深。海军蓝与近黑前景体块逐渐过渡到层叠的蓝绿、绿松石中间调，最后抵达浅黄绿光心。细密平行和波纹痕迹让宽阔平面活跃，却不打断平顺的距离渐层。强斜线与水平跨越结构把目光引向压缩而发亮的消失区域。薄雾柔化远缘，少数青色轮廓光则区分最近的暗形。视觉结果寂静、神秘而宏伟，简明明度层级中藏着精密线条节奏。
theme_en: A solitary hat-wearing figure overlooking a blue canal city beneath a bridge
theme_zh: 戴帽孤影眺望蓝色运河城市和桥梁
name: Eric Drooker
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
